findings.title: Expanded composer panels push the message input and send button below the clipped mobile shell
findings.trigger: At 390x680 on a new chat with no visible in-chat prompt, expand only 执行环境 · 本机项目 and 引用与输出格式. Empty environment and skill catalogs suffice; no advanced panel or long content is needed.
findings.impact: The message input and send control disappear below the app-shell clip. Ordinary page scrolling cannot reveal them, so a user must collapse a panel before composing or sending. Both sections are valid simultaneous open states.
findings.proof: Before scrolling, app-shell is y=0..680 with scrollHeight 842; composer-slot is y=104.796875..841.875 and height 737.078125; message input is y=680.59375..768.875; send button is y=772.875..802.875. composer-slot cannot shrink, its ancestors provide no vertical scroll container, and app-shell clips overflow. At maximum page scrollY=108, app-shell clip edge is y=572 while send remains y=664.875..694.875. The :has(.prompts) overflow rule does not apply to this ordinary no-prompt state.
findings.recommendation: Provide a bounded scroll container for the expanded composer or its workspace parent so all active composer controls remain reachable within the viewport; verify the no-prompt state with both panels expanded.

methodDetails.scope: All 128 frozen web production, configuration, stylesheet, HTML and current verification-document paths; tests excluded here and reviewed separately.
methodDetails.manual: Read application and workspace ownership/lifecycle flow, every hook and shared library, every stylesheet/configuration entry and the current declared verification contracts. Reviewed all component state/effect/async ownership, mutation and receipt transitions plus native form controls through complete AST extraction; manually read high-risk and pure rendering/validation source bodies, including drafts, workflows, files, automation, imports, account/security, MCP, media, prompts and dialogs. Historical verification claims were not accepted as current evidence. Intentional owner/epoch/visibility and secret-field resets were distinguished from draft loss.
methodDetails.static: Parsed all 118 TypeScript/TSX files with an isolated TypeScript 5.9.3 AST parser: zero parse diagnostics. Inspected extracted state/ref declarations, full effects and async function bodies, resource/mutation entry points and JSX controls for every unit. AST accessibility heuristic checked 281 native inputs, 450 buttons and 15 links for absent label relationships, implicit button submit inside forms, unsafe blank links and dangerous HTML/eval patterns; no matches. This is not a full accessibility conformance test.
methodDetails.browser: Used CUA only against the current local loopback fixture and built production UI. At a 390x680 viewport expanded only the execution-environment and reference/output-format sections on a new chat without pending prompts, then inspected rendered geometry and attempted page scrolling. Saved screenshot and DOM geometry. Reset viewport, closed the temporary IAB tab and stopped only the preview process launched for this audit. No full test suite or product changes.
methodDetails.integrity: Individually recomputed SHA-256 for all 128 inspected paths against inventory.hashes; zero mismatches. Independently ran snapshot(undefined,true) and verified the complete 1883-file source digest. Audit helpers and evidence only written under .work.
